tools.name: vcgc_commercial_status
tools.description: Read readiness counts, blocked IDs and evidence scope only.

tools.name: vcgc_deployment_plan
tools.description: Return immutable proposed plan from approved manifest registry; do not execute it.

tools.name: vcgc_license_explain
tools.description: Return sanitized decision reason; no raw license, keys, device identifiers or activation.

tools.name: vcgc_evidence_query
tools.description: Query fixed indexed receipts by ID/hash with pagination and not_modified.

lifecycle: stdin EOF => clean owned child exit
implementation_requirements: request maximum 64 KiB, response maximum 32 KiB; excess returns bounded error
max 20 rows default; full evidence available by local artifact hash, not automatic model context
strict schemas, duplicate keys rejected; unknown tool rejected
resolve IDs against fixed allowlist; caller cannot supply arbitrary filesystem paths, shell arguments, URLs or SQL
readOnlyHint is descriptive metadata, not enforcement; enforce side-effect denial in implementation
unchanged source etag => not_modified; stale/test receipts remain scope-labelled
never infer that stdio on a PC is reachable from a cloud client; client registration is separate
do not run native read verbs until their actual side effects have been audited

token_budget.billing_claim: None; payload bounds are not provider token or cost measurements

sd_d_traceability: CAND-VCGC-COM-* IDs are provisional; no official central number is claimed.
